thread:
Jamie: Heads-up — proposing a Canary for Metalpine (Dedicated) next Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC. Need approvals + confirm KMS window. Can everyone ack?
Mike: +1 from infra, we have capacity on the reserved pool that window.
Sarah: Checking with Security — KMS rotation scheduled 02:15-02:45 UTC by Ops. That overlaps.
Lee: If KMS rotates, private tenants hit kms-unavailable errors for ~30s during key refresh. We should avoid overlap or request rotation delay.
Jamie: Ugh. Option A: move canary to 03:00-04:30 UTC. Option B: ask ops to delay KMS until after canary. Which is easier?
Ops-Oncall: We can delay rotation by 2h but need sign-off from compliance. Last-minute requests okay but prefer 24h notice.
Jamie: Ok, leaning to move canary to 04:00-05:30 UTC to avoid churn and give compliance time. Anyone blocked by that?
Mike: Works for infra. Will reserve the Metalpine dedicated slice and pin capacity.
Sarah: Compliance confirmed delay is fine if we file the change request now. I filed CHG-2026-8452.
Jamie: Thanks. Locking target window: Tue 04:00-05:30 UTC. Canary details below — please read and ack.
Jamie: Canary rollout plan (short):
```yaml
tenant: metalpine
mode: dedicated
version: redwood-runtime:v2.9.0
model_variant: model_serving:v3.2.1-quant
traffic: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% (15m steps)
rollback_criteria:
  - errors_pct > 5% sustained 5m
  - p99_latency_ms > 800 for 10m
  - golden_eval_fails: >1/3 promptset
monitoring: prometheus, logs -> console.trace
```
Lee: Important — model variant pinned to v3.2.1-quant. If runtime fallback occurs, we must not auto-upgrade to non-quant. Add explicit fallback target.
Jamie: Good call. Adding fallback: fallback_variant: model_serving:v3.2.0-safe
Sarah: Security note: ensure audit logging enabled for key usage during the window. Ops-Oncall, can you confirm?
Ops-Oncall: Audit logging is on by default for that cluster; I verified.
Mike: Infra preflight checklist:
- Node health OK
- KVCACHE primed for tenant prefix
- Autoscaler cooldown set to 10m
- Canary slices reserved
I will run preflight 1h before window.
Jamie: Everyone please react with :thumbsup: to approve the window and plan, or raise concerns now.
Sarah: :thumbsup: (approve)
Mike: :thumbsup:
Lee: :thumbsup: but keep me in the channel for fast rollback decision.
deploybot: preflight triggered by Mike at 03:00 UTC — running checks: node-health, kvcache-priming, image-pulls, permission-checks.
deploybot: preflight result: PASS (nodes: OK, kvcache: primed, images: pulled, perms: ok)
Jamie: Nice — preflight green. Final ask: Ops-Oncall, we need a documented rollback hotpath and on-call contact list in the playbook.
Ops-Oncall: Added hotpath to CHG-2026-8452 and playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metalpine-canary. Contact list updated.
Jamie: Perfect. Scheduling note for release docs: add release-notes snippet about version pin and quantization tradeoffs. I'll draft.
Mike: Also enabling additional logging for first 30m of canary: token-level traces + latency buckets. Expect some metric noise.
Lee: If we see error spikes but traffic still low, we decide with a 2-person unblock (Engineer + PM) to pause vs rollback. Keep decision time < 10m.
Sarah: Acknowledged. I'll stand by for compliance confirmation once CHG goes into review.
Jamie: All approvals present. Final thumbs: please post a final :white_check_mark: here when you push the schedule into the calendar and runbook.
Mike: :white_check_mark: calendar invite sent, reserved infra slice.
Ops-Oncall: :white_check_mark: CHG updated and rotation delayed.
deploybot: scheduling canary job: deploy --tenant metalpine --version redwood-runtime:v2.9.0 --slice reserved-metalpine --schedule "2026-05-12T04:00:00Z"
deploybot: note: automated rollback hook: trigger_rollback.sh --reason "errors_pct" --threshold 5
Jamie: Thanks. I'll post the release notes and runbook link to the customer preflight thread. We'll monitor in #eng-runtime and this thread for quick updates.
Lee: Copy. I'll be on standby.
Sarah: I'm pulling the golden promptset and will run a sanity eval 10m before canary.
Jamie: Great — thread locked unless a new blocker appears. Appreciate everyone's fast responses :pray:
